# team-process-software.md
# Software development extension for team-process.md.
# Generated by solera-init when project.type = "software".
# Merged into team-process.md — do not use as a standalone file.

tech_stack:
  backend:
    framework: ""      # e.g. "Spring Boot 3.3" / "Django 5" / "NestJS 10"
    orm: ""            # e.g. "JPA / Hibernate" / "Prisma" / "TypeORM"
    auth: ""           # e.g. "JWT (access 30m / refresh 7d)" / "Session"
    database: ""       # e.g. "PostgreSQL 16" / "MySQL 8" / "MongoDB 7"
  frontend:
    framework: ""      # e.g. "Next.js 14 (App Router)" / "Vue 3" / "React 18"
    state: ""          # e.g. "Zustand" / "Redux Toolkit" / "Pinia" / "none"
    styling: ""        # e.g. "Tailwind CSS v3" / "CSS Modules" / "styled-components"
  infra:
    cloud: ""          # e.g. "AWS" / "GCP" / "Azure" / "none"
    container: ""      # e.g. "Docker + ECS Fargate" / "Kubernetes" / "none"
    ci_cd: ""          # e.g. "GitHub Actions" / "Jenkins" / "none"
    environments: []   # e.g. [dev, staging, prod]
    deploy_approval: "" # e.g. "auto" / "manual approval required"
